dispersion: sample standard deviation of per-seed mean times; all observations retained
gaussian: finite-precision inverse-CDF discrete Gaussian, truncated at 14 sigma; variable time
random_stream: AES-256-CTR; public benchmark seeds; not production key seeding
polynomial_backend: NTT for dense products; exact sparse multiplication for ternary challenges
system_setup: NTT roots, Gaussian CDFs, h, a, a_sig and common fixed spectra excluded from per-operation timing
keygen: one vehicle and one parameter set, including user secret, KGC partial secret, pseudonym, KEM keys and partial-key validation; no blockchain/network
verify: single signature authentication plus norm and accumulator-update checks; not unsigncryption
rejection: actual joint rejection sampling with M=exp(1+1/144); all unsuccessful attempts timed
serialization: length-delimited little-endian int32 polynomials; 2-bit packed reconciliation auxiliary values; byte payloads
exclusions: network, blockchain, persistent replay-log I/O, HMAC sessions, security reductions and side-channel hardening
ntt_acceleration_measurement: Five uncached dense products per set, outside the operation timing, versus schoolbook multiplication; small microbenchmark, not a system speedup.
